segments.zh: 好吧，这是回答您实际上不知道如何回答的问题的好方法。

segments.en: In this case, Mr. Ford doesn't have the answer to this, this audience member's question, like you said, Marco.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，就像你说的，Marco，福特先生回答不了这位观众的问题。

segments.en: He just says, I will have to get back to you on that.
segments.zh: 他只是说，我将不得不回复你。

segments.en: I will have to let you know later.
segments.zh: 稍后我将不得不告诉你。

segments.en: So it's a much better, so it's much better to say, I will get back to you instead of saying, I don't know.
segments.zh: 所以它要好得多，所以最好说，我会回复你而不是说，我不知道。

segments.en: For example, if your boss asks you, I don't know, how were sales last year compared to this year?
segments.zh: 比如说，你老板问你，呃……去年的销售和今年比怎么样？

segments.en: And if you don't know, it's really not recommendable to say, I don't know.
segments.zh: 如果你不知道，真的不建议说，我不知道。

segments.en: You don't want to say, I don't know.
segments.zh: 你不想说，我不知道。

segments.en: It makes you sound like you don't know anything.
segments.zh: 它让你听起来像你什么都不知道。

segments.en: So in this case, you say, listen, I really have to get back to you about that.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，你说，听着，我真的必须回复你。

segments.en: I want to check some numbers.
segments.zh: 我想检查一些数字。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Okay, so moving on to our next phrase.
segments.zh: 好的，继续我们的下一个短语。

segments.en: When finally he was going to present the ad campaign, he said, so without further ado, the new 420 marketing campaign.
segments.zh: 当他终于要展示广告活动时，他说，那么事不宜迟，全新的 420 营销活动来了。

segments.en: This phrase, without further ado, is something that we commonly hear in speeches or more formal occasions, but it's something that we say when we want to introduce something.
segments.zh: 这个短语，不用多说，是我们在演讲或更正式的场合中经常听到的，但当我们想介绍一些东西时，我们会说它。

segments.en: We say, we're not going to talk about it anymore.
segments.zh: 我们说，我们不会再谈论它了。

segments.en: Let's just do it.
segments.zh: 让我们去做吧。

segments.en: Let's just show you.
segments.zh: 让我们向您展示。

segments.en: So the word ado, is this, this is I think like classic English.
segments.zh: 所以 ado 这个词，我觉得算是很古典的英语。

segments.en: It's not really common to hear it anymore.
segments.zh: 听到它不再常见了。

segments.en: No, there is actually a very famous play by Shakespeare called Much Ado About Nothing.
segments.zh: 不，实际上有一部非常有名的莎士比亚戏剧，叫做《无事生非》。

segments.en: And that means, you know, that there's a lot of talking and a lot of problems and a lot of drama about this one thing.
segments.zh: 意思是说，关于这一件事有很多闲话、很多麻烦，还闹出很多风波。

segments.en: And so basically when we say the phrase without further ado, we're saying, you know, without further talking, talking about this anymore.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，我们说 without further ado 这个短语，意思就是，不再多说了。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So it's a nice way to say, okay, finally we're going to do this, or finally we're going to see this.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个很好的表达方式，好吧，最后我们要这样做，或者我们最终会看到这个。

segments.en: And obviously the video was not the campaign.
segments.zh: 显然视频并不是推广活动。

segments.en: It was his golfing holiday in Barbados.
segments.zh: 这是他在巴巴多斯的高尔夫假期。

segments.en: So he asked someone if he could take five.
segments.zh: 所以他问能不能休息五分钟。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: This phrase to take five is very, very common in English.
segments.zh: 这个短语在英语中非常非常常见。

segments.en: And it's just another way to say, can we take a five minute break?
segments.zh: 这只是另一种说法，我们可以休息五分钟吗？

segments.en: So maybe you can ask your teacher, excuse me, can we, can we take five or, or something like that?
segments.zh: 所以也许你可以问你的老师，不好意思，我们可以休息五分钟吗，或者类似的说法？

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Or, hey guys, I'm, I'm, I need a glass of water.
segments.zh: 或者，嘿，伙计们，我是，我需要一杯水。

segments.en: Let's take five.
segments.zh: 我们休息五分钟吧。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So that means let's have a short break.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着让我们有一个短暂的休息时间。

segments.en: Let's take a five minute break, but it doesn't always necessarily have to be five minutes.
segments.zh: 让我们休息五分钟，但不一定总是五分钟。

segments.en: Now it can be seven minutes or 10 minutes, but take five means a short break.
segments.zh: 也可能是七分钟或十分钟，但 take five 意思就是短暂休息一下。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So you don't say, can we take 10 or can we take seven?
segments.zh: 所以你不会说，我们可以休息十吗，或者休息七吗？

segments.en: Now usually just say take five, take five.
segments.zh: 通常只会说 take five、休息五分钟。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a lot of phrases there, a lot of great stuff.
segments.zh: 所以那里有很多短语，很多很棒的东西。

segments.en: Let's review it one last time.
segments.zh: 让我们最后一次回顾一下。

segments.en: So as I mentioned previously, the campaign advertisement will focus on those key elements that every consumer looks for in a quality laptop, affordability, quality, speed, and reliability.
segments.zh: 正如我之前提到的，活动广告将专注于每个消费者在优质笔记本电脑中寻找的关键要素、可负担性、质量、速度和可靠性。

segments.en: We have pulled out all the stops to produce a product that really rivals all our competitors.
segments.zh: 我们竭尽全力生产出真正与所有竞争对手相媲美的产品。

segments.en: Actually, just to illustrate my point, let me give you an anecdote here.
segments.zh: 实际上，只是为了说明我的观点，让我在这里给你一个轶事。

segments.en: I remember last year I was playing golf with one of our key suppliers.
segments.zh: 我记得去年我和我们的主要供应商之一打高尔夫球。

segments.en: It was a lovely summer afternoon.
segments.zh: 这是一个可爱的夏日午后。

segments.en: Anyway, I invited our supplier for a game of golf and wanted to get his input on the new X420.
segments.zh: 无论如何，我邀请我们的供应商参加高尔夫比赛，并希望获得他对新 X420 的意见。

segments.en: Actually, I often get together with him for a good game of golf.
segments.zh: 实际上，我经常和他一起打一场精彩的高尔夫球比赛。

segments.en: It really is a wonderful way to relax.
segments.zh: 这真的是一种很好的放松方式。

segments.en: To be honest, I'm not that great at golf, but I've improved in the last few years.
segments.zh: 老实说，我在高尔夫方面不是很擅长，但在过去的几年里我已经进步了。

segments.en: But the key to golf is practice, practice, practice.
segments.zh: 但高尔夫的关键是练习、练习、练习。

segments.en: I'm sorry, I've lost my thread.
segments.zh: 抱歉，我刚才说到哪儿了。

segments.en: What was I talking about again?
segments.zh: 我又在说什么？

segments.en: I think you were discussing the campaign advertisement, Michael.
segments.zh: 迈克尔，你刚才好像在介绍推广广告。

segments.en: Yes, excuse me.
segments.zh: 那个，打扰一下。

segments.en: I'm afraid I got sidetracked there.
segments.zh: 恐怕我刚才跑题了。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Anyway, the campaign.
segments.zh: 总之，还是说回推广活动。

segments.en: Well, let me see.
segments.zh: 嗯，让我看看。

segments.en: Is the projector working yet, Jonathan?
segments.zh: 乔纳森，投影仪修好了吗？

segments.en: No, sorry.
segments.zh: 不行，抱歉。

segments.en: IT is still fixing it.
segments.zh: IT 部门还在修。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, all the information on the campaign is on the PowerPoint.
segments.zh: 好吧，有关活动的所有信息都在 PowerPoint 上。

segments.en: I haven't actually got my notes with me.
segments.zh: 我实际上没有随身携带笔记。

segments.en: Let me see.
segments.zh: 让我看看。

segments.en: Mr. Ford, could you at least tell us the schedule for the campaign?
segments.zh: 福特先生，您至少能告诉我们推广活动的时间安排吧？

segments.en: When are the first advertisements scheduled for?
segments.zh: 第一期广告的安排是什么时候？

segments.en: That's a good question.
segments.zh: 这是个好问题。

segments.en: Unfortunately, I don't have that information on me.
segments.zh: 不幸的是，我没有这些信息。

segments.en: I'll have to get back to you on that point.
segments.zh: 在这一点上我必须回复你。

segments.en: Okay, Michael.
segments.zh: 好的，迈克尔。

segments.en: The projector is fixed.
segments.zh: 投影仪修好了。

segments.en: I think we're ready.
segments.zh: 我想我们准备好了。

segments.en: Thank goodness.
segments.zh: 谢天谢地。

segments.en: Okay, everyone.
segments.zh: 好了，各位。

segments.en: Sorry for the delay.
segments.zh: 抱歉，让大家久等了。

segments.en: So without further ado, the new X420 marketing campaign.
segments.zh: 因此，事不宜迟，新的 X420 营销活动。

segments.en: Enjoy.
segments.zh: 请享用。

segments.en: Oh, I'm terribly sorry.
segments.zh: 哦，实在抱歉。

segments.en: This is not the advert.
segments.zh: 这不是广告。

segments.en: This is my golfing holiday in Barbados.
segments.zh: 这是我在巴巴多斯的高尔夫假期。

segments.en: I think I must have brought the wrong file.
segments.zh: 我想我一定带来了错误的文件。

segments.en: Can we take five?
segments.zh: 我们休息五分钟好吗？

segments.en: Come on, Mr. Ford.
segments.zh: 来吧，福特先生。

segments.en: Okay, so we're coming towards the end of our presentation series.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们即将结束我们的演示系列。

segments.en: So be sure to listen to us next week when we're talking about presentation series part nine.
segments.zh: 因此，当我们谈论演示系列第九部分时，请务必在下周听取我们的意见。

segments.en: And as you may know, it ends with part 10.
segments.zh: 你可能知道，它以第 10 部分结束。

segments.en: So then we'll start with a new series very, very soon.
segments.zh: 那么我们很快就会从一个新系列开始。

segments.en: And I don't know if you have any questions or any suggestions about a series, you can always contact us.
segments.zh: 我不知道您是否对系列有任何问题或任何建议，您可以随时与我们联系。

segments.en: Yeah, please do let us know what are the things that you have a hard time with when you're studying English?
segments.zh: 是的，请让我们知道您在学习英语时遇到的困难是什么？

segments.en: Are there things that are confusing or difficult?
segments.zh: 有没有令人困惑或困难的事情？

segments.en: We're happy to hear your suggestions and we hope that we can help out.
segments.zh: 我们很高兴听到您的建议，我们希望我们能提供帮助。

segments.en: That's about it for us today, though.
segments.zh: 不过，今天的内容差不多就到这里。

segments.en: So until next time, bye.
segments.zh: 所以直到下一次，再见。

segments.en: Bye, everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。
